crossRefs.note: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men, and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer…

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men, and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,
translations.bsb: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,
translations.kjv: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
translations.asv: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, even to all the people that had given him that answer, saying,
